title: Stanley Park Self Guided Bike Tour
includes: Multilingual Commentary (English, Chinese (Mandarin), French, German, Japanese, Korean, Spanish)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

blurb: Explore at your own pace with the Stanley Park Self Guided Bike Tour in Vancouver. This audio tour plays directly on your phone. Simply follow the designated route and expert local commentary plays directly to your device based on your real time location.
